items.heading: מבאר חזרת האורות אל המאציל לקבל תשלומיהם, ובו כ"ב ענינים: — בהתפשטות א' דעקודים לא יצאו האורות שלמים וע"כ חזרו לשורשם להשתלם ועי"ז נעשה כלי
items.html: *And we shall explain the emergence of these lights, which are called Akudim. Know that 1at the time they emerged they did not emerge complete, and the reason for the matter is that the Emanator’s intention was now to make the beginning of the coming into being of the vessels, to clothe the light for the need of the receivers, so that they would be able to receive, 2and therefore, since they emerged incomplete and unfinished, they returned and rose to their root to be corrected and to be completed, and through this a vessel was made.

items.heading: בהתפ"א היו אור הזך שהוא או"י ואור העב שהוא או"ח מעורבים זב"ז, אלא בהסתלקות לשורשם נשאר אור העב למטה שלא היה יכול לעלות ונתוספה עביותו ונעשה כלי
items.html: And the matter is that certainly 3the phase of the vessels was in potential, although it was not in actuality within the light, for it was 4in the phase of the coarser and grosser light, except that it was 5joined in essence thoroughly, and therefore its phase was not revealed. For when 6the light emerged through the Peh [mouth] and outward, it all emerged mixed together; 7and when they returned to rise and to be completed, then certainly, through the emergence of the light outside the Peh, that light which is the phase of the vessels, which is coarser, now acquired greater coarseness, and through this 8it too could not return to its source as at first, and the refined light expanded away from it and rose to its source. 9And then there was added to the aforementioned coarse light yet more coarseness upon its coarseness, and then the phase of the vessel was finished and remained.

items.heading: אע"פ שחזר האור למקומו בהתפ"ב על המסך דבחי"ג מ"מ לא נתבטל אור העב מלהיות בחינת כלי, משום שבהתפשטות ב' היה חסר אור הכתר
items.html: And should you say that when the refined light returns to descend and to expand in the vessel, 10the vessel will once more be refined as at first and will cease to be a phase of vessel — the answer to this is that not all the ten Sefirot that had risen to their source returned and descended, but the nine lower ones alone descended, while the uppermost, which is Keter, remained always with the Emanator. And thus it turns out 20that it is the light of Hochma that returned to clothe in the vessel of Keter, and so too all the rest of the Sefirot; and the vessels are able to receive the light, which is now diminished for them from what they had at first.

items.heading: התפ"א של עקודים יצאה בבחינת נפש לבד
items.html: And now know that 30they all emerged in the phase of Nefesh alone. And this is the secret of the verse, “The Lord has sworn by His Nefesh,” for the emanation that is called Nekudim, as we have said, which is called HaVaYaH, swore by One who is greater than it, and that is the world of Akudim, which emerged in the phase of Nefesh alone. And in this, look deeply and see how deep are His thoughts, for even the upper world of Akudim is nothing but the phase of Nefesh alone.

items.heading: בעקודים יצאו הכלים ממטה למעלה, תחילה כלי מלכות ולבסוף הכתר, בהיפך מנקודים שיצאו שם הכלים ממעלה למטה
items.html: And now, all the ten Sefirot emerged, but they did not all emerge together; rather, first the phase of Malchut of the world of Akudim emerged, the opposite of the world of Nekudim. And as is written in its place.

items.heading: תחילה יצאה מלכות בבחינת נפש, ואח"כ כשיצא היסוד בבחינת נפש, נתוספה ממנו הארת רוח למלכות
items.html: And this Malchut emerged in the phase of Nefesh alone, for there is no Sefira that does not have the phase of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama (NRN), as is known; however, they emerged now only in the phase of Nefesh alone. And now, 40first Malchut emerged in the phase of Nefesh, and afterwards, when the phase of Yesod emerged, 50there was revealed in Yesod only the phase of Nefesh alone for itself, but 60an illumination was added in Malchut, in that the phase of Ruach was revealed in her.

items.heading: אור הרוח בא מן ו"ק דז"א, וע"כ ביסוד התחיל אור הרוח להתגלות, ונשתלם עם ביאת החסד דז"א
items.html: And the reason for the matter is that the secret of Ruach comes from the VAK, as is known, and therefore, when Yesod came, the phase of Ruach began to be revealed in Malchut, 70and it is not entirely completed until all the VAK emerge, which is from Yesod up to Hesed, and then the whole phase of Ruach of Malchut is finished. And as each one of them came, one end of the phase of Ruach was revealed in Malchut, as is written in the Zohar, Truma.

items.heading: ה' חסדים הם, חג"ת נ"ה כנגד ה' הבחינות כח"ב תו"מ, ויסוד אינו חסד פרטי אלא הוא הכולל של כל ה' חסדים חג"ת נ"ה
items.html: And it is already known that Yesod is not of the number of the VAK, for they are 80only five Hassadim, from Hesed to Hod; but 90Yesod does not take a particular Hesed for itself, rather all five ends are included in it. It follows that the phase of the generality of Ruach is what was revealed in Malchut when Yesod came; but when Hod, or Netzah, or the like of the other Sefirot emerged, then the phase of the actual ends of Ruach was revealed in Malchut.

items.heading: כשיצא יסוד דז"א נתגלתה כללות הנפש דז"א, וכשיצא ההוד נתגלה קצה א' דנפש ז"א וכו', עד שנשלמו הו' קצוות
items.html: And now, all this is what pertains to the phase of Malchut; but what pertains to the six ends of Zeir Anpin is in this manner: when Yesod emerged, then the phase of the generality of the five ends of Zeir Anpin is revealed, in the phase of Nefesh alone; but when Hod came, then one end of the Nefesh of Zeir Anpin is revealed. And so on, until all six ends were completed.

items.heading: כל קצה וקצה מחג"ת נ"ה כשיצאו נתנו כללות הארת הנפש ביסוד. אבל בה' הבחינות עצמן אין אחד מוסיף כלום לחברו
items.html: There is a further 100difference between Yesod and the other five ends, namely: when Hod came it gave the force of its generality anew into Yesod, the phase of Nefesh alone, and so all of them, until Hesed emerged, and it too, upon emerging, gave the force of its generality into Yesod. This is not so with the other five ends, for when one of them came it added no addition whatsoever to its fellow, since they are all equal. Only when all six were completed was the whole of Zeir Anpin finished in the phase of Nefesh.

items.heading: כשיצאה בינה היתה לעצמה בנפש, ורוח לז"א, ונשמה למלכות. וכשיצאה חכמה היתה נפש לעצמה, ורוח לבינה וכו'. וכשיצא כתר היה בנפש לעצמו ורוח לאבא וכו'
items.html: 200And afterwards Bina emerged, in the phase of Nefesh alone for herself, and the phase of Ruach for Zeir Anpin, and the phase of Neshama for Malchut. And afterwards Hochma emerged, in the phase of Nefesh for itself, and the phase of Ruach for Bina, and the phase of Neshama for Zeir Anpin, and the phase of Haya for Malchut. Afterwards Keter emerged in the phase of Nefesh for itself, and the phase of Ruach for Aba, and the phase of Neshama for Ima, and the phase of Haya for Zeir Anpin, and the phase of Yechida for Malchut.

items.heading: כשיצא כתר היה בו נפש לבד. וגם בחינה זו לא נשארה בו, כי נסתלקה למאציל
items.html: And thus, when Keter came, which is the last of them all, it emerged only in the phase of Nefesh alone. And this is the secret of the verse, “The Lord has sworn by His Nefesh,” in the manner stated above. And even this phase of 300the Nefesh of Keter did not remain in the world of Akudim, as above, for it returned and became concealed, and remained attached in its place in its Emanator.

items.heading: בבוא כתר היו למלכות נרנח"י ושאר הספירות היו חסרות, והוצרכו לחזור אל המאציל
items.html: Indeed, when Keter came, Malchut is found complete with all five inner lights, which are Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida (NRNHY). And now all the Sefirot were still deficient (as above), for they emerged deficient, without their completion, and this was truly by complete intention (as above), and therefore they had to return and rise to the Emanator, to receive their completion from Him.

items.heading: הכתר יצא אחרון וחזר ראשון. ומלכות יצאה ראשונה וחזרה אחרונה
items.html: And indeed now, in the return, 400Keter returned before them all; it turns out that it emerged last and entered first. 1And with Malchut it was the opposite, for she emerged first and entered last. And this is the secret of the verse, “I am first and I am last.” And the explanation of this verse holds true both for the Sefira of Keter and for the Sefira of Malchut, except that this one is the reverse of that one. And it is as is known, that “Ani” [I] is an appellation for Malchut, and its inversion, “Ain” [naught], is an appellation for Keter.

items.heading: בהעלם הכתר עלתה מלכות במקום יסוד. ועי"ז קיבלה מלכות מקיף דחיה, וז"א קיבל יחידה, ובינה חיה, וחכמה נשמה
items.html: 2And now, when Keter became concealed to its source, Hochma rose to the place of Keter, and Bina to the place of Hochma, and so in this way all of them, until Malchut was found in the place of Yesod. And through this ascent to the place of Yesod, 3the light was added in her, and she had one phase of surrounding light corresponding to the phase of the inner Haya. Zeir Anpin too rose by one degree, and the phase of Yechida of the inner lights was added in it, 4and now the five inner lights were completed for it. 5And in Bina, the phase of the inner Haya was added. 6And in Hochma, the phase of the inner Neshama was added.

items.heading: כשעלתה חכמה נתוספה בבינה יחידה וז"א קיבל מקיף דחיה, ומלכות מקיף דיחידה
items.html: 7And afterwards Hochma rose into the Emanator, and Bina rose to the place of Keter, and the phase of the inner Yechida was added in her, 8and she was completed in all five inner lights. 9And in Zeir Anpin, one surrounding light was added, corresponding to the inner Haya. And in Malchut a yet higher surrounding light was added, which corresponds to the inner Yechida.

items.heading: כשעלתה בינה נתוסף בז"א מקיף דיחידה, ויותר מזה לא הרויחו ז"א ומלכות
items.html: And afterwards 10Hesed rose to the place of Keter, for Bina had risen into her Emanator, 20and then there was added in ZA also the phase of a second, upper surrounding light, which corresponds to the inner Yechida. And from there onwards 30Zeir Anpin and Malchut gained nothing further, and no further addition of light was added in them.

items.heading: בכל בחינה ובחינה יש י"ס ונכללות בה' הן בפנימיים והן במקיפין
items.html: And the matter is by way of one introduction that you must know, namely, that it has already been explained above that in each and every phase of each and every world, and in every Partzuf, there are ten Sefirot in it, no fewer and no more, and they are ten inner lights and ten surrounding. However, the ten inner ones are included in five only, which correspond to the five phases of Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf] that they have, as mentioned elsewhere, and they are AA, AVI, and ZON; and these themselves are called the NRNHY of the generality of each and every world by itself. And so, in this way, with the surrounding lights, which are 40ten and are included in five.

items.heading: בע"ס דראש יש ה' אורות פנימיים וה' אורות מקיפים, אבל מפה ולמטה דא"ק יש רק ה' פנימיים וב' מקיפים יחידה חיה
items.html: Indeed know that in all the lights and the worlds and the Partzufim that are 50from the Hotem [nose] of Adam Kadmon upward, in every Partzuf, all these phases are always complete, which are: five inner lights, each comprising ten particular Sefirot as above, and five surrounding lights comprising ten particular Sefirot. 60But from the Peh [mouth] of Adam Kadmon downward, to the end of all the worlds, there are only five inner lights and the two upper surrounding lights, which correspond to Yechida and Haya, and no more, for the light was diminished from there onward. Therefore, in the world of Akudim, which are the lights that emerge from the Peh of Adam Kadmon outward, there were in it only five inner lights and two surrounding lights, and no more. And remember this introduction.

items.heading: בהמשך זמן עלית הכתר למאציל נסתלק גילוי יחידה ממלכות
items.html: *And know that when Keter rose to the Emanator, then, for that same measure and duration of time during which it was rising, then from Malchut 70the phase of the revelation of Yechida departed from her, which is the light that was drawn to her from Keter; for since Keter was rising and departing, its intention was not to illuminate in her. 80However, the record alone remained in her.

items.heading: כשסיים כתר עליתו למאציל חזר גילוי יחידה למלכות
items.html: And when Keter finished becoming concealed, 90and Malchut finished rising up to the Sium of Yesod, then 100the Emanator returned to illuminate in her, as at first, the phase of the Yechida that is in her. For after Keter rose into the Emanator, she too rose into Yesod, and was one degree nearer to the Emanator, and she was now receiving from Him what she had previously been receiving from Keter. But so long as Keter had not finished rising, then 200Keter interposed between her Emanator and her, and Keter itself likewise did not illuminate in her. And so, in this way, it is with the phase of Haya that she receives from Keter. And so, in this way, with Hochma and Bina and the like.

items.heading: בהמשך זמן עלית חכמה למאציל נסתלק גילוי חיה ממלכות. וכשחכמה סיימה עלייתה חזר גילוי חיה למלכות
items.html: And likewise, when Hochma rose upward into its Emanator, there departed from Malchut the portion that reached her from it, and there remained in her only the record alone, until Hochma completed its ascent to its Emanator, and then the light returned as at first. And infer from this to all the rest, for there are many divisions. For when 300Hochma began to rise into Keter, its illumination departed from all that is below it; and once it had already risen into Keter, then it returned as at first. And when it returned a second time to rise into the Emanator, the light departed a second time; and when it finished rising, the light returned to its full strength. And the one who studies will understand the other divisions in this manner, in the matter of the surrounding lights of ZON that they take at the time of their return and their departure upward.
